races.name: Radnor Hills Water Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: First Candidate
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest official rating but faces tactical disadvantage if Enya controls the pace throughout
runners_data.comment: Entitled to win at Haydock last time and entitled to win this, even with a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who built on her early hurdling promise with a comfortable defeat of a subsequent winner at Haydock (1m7f, good; 1-4); she was entitled to win that and she's entitled to win this, even with a penalty.

runners_data.name: Enya
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to being unopposed early, with Jamie Snowden's 4/12 recent record adding confidence

runners_data.name: Peace Of Amaron
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 144-day absence for trainer with poor recent record, needs strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Silvereen
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer who requires genuine gallop to show best form, 52 days off may have freshened her up

runners_data.name: Briery Rose
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare carrying penalty weight at 156lbs, needs everything to fall right from unpromising tactical position

runners_data.name: Bits Ballou
runners_data.note: Modest ability hold-up horse whose recent form suggests she's regressing, 156lbs burden looks prohibitive

runners_data.name: Dame In Disguise
runners_data.note: Needs significant improvement wearing prong cheekpieces, hold-up style unsuited to likely pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Enya will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the front, with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field of seven. The prominent mare faces no early pressure and can dictate terms throughout, setting a steady rhythm that should suit her stamina-oriented profile. With First Candidate, Peace Of Amaron, Silvereen, Briery Rose, Bits Ballou and Dame In Disguise all content to settle behind, this becomes a waiting game until the home turn. This race shape heavily favours front-runners and those who can travel prominently, as the lack of early pace will create a tactical affair that punishes hold-up horses relying on a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Enya Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Enya gets an uncontested lead and maintains her rhythm without pressure
scenarios.body: She can use her stamina to kick clear approaching the last hurdle, with the hold-up horses struggling to make inroads from too far back in a steadily-run race. The lack of early pace means those settling at the rear face an impossible task against a mare who has dictated ideal fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If First Candidate's class tells in the closing stages despite the lack of early pace
scenarios.body: The OR 118 mare has superior ability and Harry Skelton's tactical nous could see her positioned closer than usual, allowing her to strike late despite the modest gallop. Her recent Haydock success suggests she can overcome tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as the field bunches up
scenarios.body: This creates opportunities for those settling in midfield positions to get competitive, with the race becoming more tactical than stamina-sapping. Silvereen and Peace Of Amaron could benefit from improved positioning and a more genuinely-run contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire and one of the outsiders finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: The modest pace could bring the entire field into contention, allowing a horse like Briery Rose or Dame In Disguise to outrun their odds through better tactical positioning. However, this requires multiple market leaders to underperform simultaneously.

watchPoints.text: First Candidate's early positioning - if Harry Skelton places her closer to the pace than usual, she becomes extremely dangerous with her class advantage
Enya's jumping under pressure - any mistakes at the business end could open the door for late challengers in what should be her race to lose
The pace from halfway - if it quickens significantly this changes the entire complexion and brings hold-up horses into play
Peace Of Amaron's fitness after 144 days off - any signs of rustiness or blowing would confirm the lengthy absence has dulled her edge
First Candidate's market movement - any significant support suggests connections expect her to overcome the tactical setup

races.name: Lion Leintwardine Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Briery Butterfly
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning from 39-day break with form figures suggesting consistency but lacks a recent win

runners_data.name: Shorten Sassy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with 3lb claimer aboard, trainer Mel Rowley in excellent form with 100% strike rate over past 14 days

runners_data.name: Churchman
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent performer whose recent good ground form shows consistent placing ability but struggles to win

runners_data.name: Athena's Dream
runners_data.note: Young 4-year-old with 7lb claimer Miss Megan Bevan, wears blinkers and has shown gradual improvement this season

runners_data.name: Edna E Mode
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying top weight at 159lbs, trainer Robert Stephens seeking first winner in past 14 days

runners_data.name: Slack Alice
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with visor fitted, Sean Bowen's presence adds tactical expertise for patient ride from rear

runners_data.name: Son Of Tyran
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning finishing record lately, Harry Skelton booking suggests stable confidence despite poor recent form

runners_data.name: Joker Jack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with patchy recent form and unproven trainer Claire Hitch having her first runners in this period

races.paceDynamic: Briery Butterfly will take the field along at a sustainable gallop with fellow prominent runners Shorten Sassy, Churchman, Athena's Dream, Edna E Mode, and Joker Jack all positioned within striking distance. This creates a moderate early pace without punishing tempo, as no horse needs to commit aggressively to secure position. The two hold-up horses Slack Alice and Son Of Tyran will track from the rear, relying on the steady gallop to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and have something left for the finish, as they avoid the risk of being too far back on a day when the pace may not collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace holds and the front group stays together until the home turn
scenarios.body: The prominent runners maintain striking positions throughout and have enough left to repel late challenges. Briery Butterfly, Shorten Sassy, and Churchman are ideally placed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens enough in the middle stages to set up a strong finish
scenarios.body: Slack Alice and Son Of Tyran benefit from increased tempo stretching the field and creating gaps for their late runs. Sean Bowen's tactical nous aboard Slack Alice becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustainable Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Briery Butterfly dictates a steady rhythm that never truly quickens
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina over speed, favouring horses who can grind out the finish rather than produce explosive turns of foot. Experience over this trip becomes paramount.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too steadily and bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where positioning and luck matter more than running style, potentially allowing an outsider to emerge. The 7-runner field creates traffic issues.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Tyran has faded badly in recent finishes despite Harry Skelton's booking, making his finishing kick highly questionable
Shorten Sassy carries Shane Quinlan's 3lb claim but faces a significant step up in class from recent opposition
Athena's Dream's 7lb claimer Miss Megan Bevan may struggle tactically if the pace becomes messy turning for home
Briery Butterfly's 39-day absence could leave her vulnerable if rivals quicken the pace in the closing stages
Slack Alice needs the pace to develop properly to unleash Sean Bowen's trademark patient ride from the rear

races.name: Radnor Hills Splash Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hall Lane
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form behind winners, 31 days off should have him fresh and the good going suits his record perfectly.

runners_data.name: Law Of Supply
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who is a non-runner, removing one key player from the back-of-field contingent.

runners_data.name: Redbridge Rambler
runners_data.note: Prominent style with excellent recent form including a win just 1 day ago, bred for this distance and going combination.
runners_data.comment: Two good runs over 3m1f in late 2025; inadequate trip latest; solid chance
runners_data.spotlight: Two good runs behind subsequent winners at Hereford and Catterick (both 3m1f, good) in late 2025; always struggling over an inadequate 1m7f at Wincanton (no headgear; cheekpieces return) in April and perhaps fortunate to get dropped 2lb; fair chance of another win.

runners_data.name: Nazare
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 47 days off with a strong trainer strike rate, needs the tactical race to develop late.

runners_data.name: Sunset Boulevard
runners_data.note: The lone early leader after 72 days off, must handle the responsibility of making the running throughout this 3m test.

runners_data.name: Zacony Rebel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse at 11 years old with recent course experience, solid on good ground but needs a strong pace to aim at.

races.paceDynamic: Sunset Boulevard is the only confirmed front runner in this 6-runner field and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely setting a sustainable gallop without pressure. Hall Lane and Redbridge Rambler both prefer prominent positions and may track close behind, creating a moderate early pace. With three hold-up horses (Law Of Supply, Nazare, Zacony Rebel) sitting off the tempo, this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace could quicken gradually through the middle stages. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the lone leader and kick when ready, avoiding the traffic problems that could ensnare the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sunset Boulevard sets a steady tempo without collapsing
scenarios.body: Hall Lane or Redbridge Rambler can stalk the leader perfectly positioned and kick clear when the pace lifts approaching the final bend. The three hold-up horses get caught behind the slow early gallop and struggle to pick up the pieces when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Sunset Boulevard maintains stamina reserves and sees out the trip
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on the tactical nature by keeping enough in hand to resist the late challengers. Hold-up horses make ground but the steady pace suits the leader's staying power over this 3m trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Nazare or Zacony Rebel get the perfect setup to unleash a telling late burst when others have shown their hands too early. The prominent horses find themselves outpaced by the sudden injection of speed in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Sunset Boulevard goes too slow early then stops quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize on the crawling pace. Law Of Supply's class could tell if getting a clear run when the tempo finally lifts approaching the business end.

watchPoints.text: Law Of Supply is listed as non-runner which removes a key hold-up threat and changes the tactical complexion significantly.
Sunset Boulevard faces the pressure of being the only front runner over 3m after a 72-day break, stamina reserves are crucial.
Redbridge Rambler ran just 1 day ago which could either have him race-fit and sharp or leave him vulnerable to fatigue.
Nazare returns from 47 days off in a tactical race where freshness versus race fitness could prove decisive.
The 6-runner field creates fewer traffic problems but makes tactical positioning even more critical for the hold-up horses.

races.name: Welsh Guards Association Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Hooper
runners_data.note: Front-running veteran making first start in 498 days with inexperienced 7lb claimer aboard

runners_data.name: Pergamon
runners_data.note: Recent winner over course and distance with strong hold-up style, trainer in good form at 2/27

runners_data.name: Zucayan
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who handles good going well, 158 days off could aid freshness

runners_data.name: Soleil d'Arizona
runners_data.note: Harry Skelton partnership with strong recent form, hold-up style suits this tactical race

runners_data.name: Ufouria
runners_data.note: Lightweight hold-up horse with decent recent form, trainer firing at 40% strike rate

runners_data.name: Lord Cauvelliere
runners_data.note: Bottom-weighted hold-up type returning after 167 days, good going record but inconsistent

runners_data.name: The Tide Turns
runners_data.note: Warning flags for fading in finish, poor recent form makes him hard to fancy despite decent rating

races.paceDynamic: Hooper will likely set the pace from the front with his prominent style, but at 10 years old and 498 days off, he may not sustain a strong gallop throughout. With six hold-up horses behind him including recent winner Pergamon and consistent Soleil d'Arizona, this creates a tactical waiting game where the pace could collapse. The lack of genuine early pace pressure means the race will be run to suit patient, finishing types who can quicken late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed over front-runners and prominent racers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hooper sets steady fractions and the pace collapses in the straight
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade led by Pergamon, Soleil d'Arizona and Zucayan get perfect conditions to unleash late kicks. Fresh legs and tactical positioning overwhelm the tired pace-setter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hooper Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Hooper's 498-day absence has left him fresher than expected and he sustains his gallop
scenarios.body: The veteran gets first run on his rivals and stays on strongly as the hold-up horses leave their runs too late. His prominent style proves tactical gold when others are caught napping.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and the race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure speed test where horses with the best turn of foot regardless of position benefit. Recent form and fitness become crucial factors in the dash to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Range Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses makes an unusually early move turning for home
scenarios.body: A horse like Zucayan or Soleil d'Arizona breaks the tactical deadlock with a sustained drive that catches rivals cold. The early move pays dividends as others struggle to respond.

watchPoints.text: Hooper's fitness after 498 days absence - if he stops quickly it opens the door for all the hold-up horses
The Tide Turns has a noted tendency to fade in the finish which could prove costly in a tactical finish
Pergamon's recent Ludlow win over course and distance gives him a clear tactical edge
Multiple hold-up horses could get in each other's way if the pace collapses too much
Harry Skelton's booking of Soleil d'Arizona suggests stable confidence despite mixed recent form

races.name: GC Rickards Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Regal Renaissance
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating but 43 days off and relies on others setting strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Northern Air
runners_data.note: Needs to settle better than recent form suggests under 5lb claimer Tom Broughton making tactical job harder

runners_data.name: Northern Symphonie
runners_data.note: Natural front runner perfectly positioned to exploit weak pace scenario but 45 days absence is concern

runners_data.name: Claim Du Brizais
runners_data.note: Dan Skelton's 31% strike rate and Harry Skelton booking suggests strong confidence despite hold-up style

runners_data.name: Ezmerellda
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed to track Northern Symphonie but lowest rating and poor recent form major negatives

races.paceDynamic: Northern Symphonie sits as the lone natural front runner and will set a comfortable tempo from the start, with Ezmerellda likely tracking in second early on. The three hold-up horses - Regal Renaissance, Northern Air, and Claim Du Brizais - will settle towards the rear, creating a clear split between pace and closers. With no pressure on Northern Symphonie through the early stages, she can dictate terms and potentially steal a march turning for home. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade may find themselves with too much ground to make up in a small field where the pace could prove insufficient for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runner gets away
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Symphonie jumps well and maintains a comfortable lead throughout
scenarios.body: She can control the race from the front and prove hard to peg back up the hill, especially with her proven stamina at this trip. The hold-up horses will struggle to close the gap in time with insufficient pace to bring them into contention.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves steady enough to set up a strong finish
scenarios.body: Regal Renaissance and Claim Du Brizais can use their class advantage to close from off the pace, with Harry Skelton's tactical nous helping Claim Du Brizais time his challenge. The front runners may tire in the closing stages on the testing Ludlow hill.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Symphonie goes too slow and allows the field to bunch up early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the highest-rated horses can assert their class advantage late. Regal Renaissance's superior rating and Sam Twiston-Davies' experience become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping errors decide
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make costly mistakes at the obstacles
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically and goes to whichever horse maintains fluency over the fences. Northern Air or Claim Du Brizais could benefit from others' misfortunes despite being out of position early.

watchPoints.text: Northern Symphonie jumping fluently early - if she gets into rhythm from the start, the hold-up horses may never get close enough
Claim Du Brizais settling kindly for Harry Skelton - needs to be closer than usual given likely modest pace
Regal Renaissance travelling strongly turning in - class horse who could overcome tactical disadvantage if race develops properly
Tom Broughton keeping Northern Air handy - inexperienced jockey may struggle with hold-up tactics in small field
Early pace through first mile - if Northern Symphonie goes too steady, hold-up horses get major advantage

races.name: Heartsease Farm Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Snapius
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid form on good ground, Bellamy's 17-day break ideal, class edge with OR 100 rating

runners_data.name: Steady The Ship
runners_data.note: Lone front runner returning after 44 days, poor recent form but uncontested lead suits, Worsley's 3lb claim helps

runners_data.name: Midnight View
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with recent win, good ground form, Sheppard team know horse well, needs strong pace to aim at

runners_data.name: Jafimgoso
runners_data.note: Quality closer for Skelton team, 60-day break suggests targeting this, hold-up style perfect for expected pace shape

runners_data.name: Izzy's Grey
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling recently, tongue-tie first time suggests breathing issues, needs career-best effort

runners_data.name: Ramaah
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent form, lightest weight bar claims, only horse with early pace besides leader

runners_data.name: Jour d'Orage
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest recent efforts, headgear suggests problems, apprentice jockey taking 3lbs

runners_data.name: Man Of Riddles
runners_data.note: Closer returning after 53 days, modest form on turf, needs significant improvement to feature

races.paceDynamic: Steady The Ship will lead uncontested from the start, with no other genuine pace horses in this field. Ramaah may track in second but prefers to sit prominent rather than pressure the leader. This creates a steady, unrushed gallop that will likely quicken late as the hold-up horses including Snapius, Midnight View, and Jafimgoso try to make their moves from off the pace. This sustainable tempo clearly favors the closers and hold-up horses who can produce their best finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Steady The Ship sets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows hold-up horses to get into perfect rhythm and unleash strong finishing efforts up the hill. Class horses like Snapius and Midnight View can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Steady The Ship builds an unassailable lead while the field sleeps.
scenarios.body: The veteran exploits the lack of early pace to steal a march, and his stamina proves decisive when the closers finally wake up too late. His recent poor form becomes irrelevant with perfect tactical conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Finish Favors Experience
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get in each other's way in the straight.
scenarios.body: Traffic problems and interference up the home straight create a scramble where experience and a clear run matter most. The jockey factor becomes crucial in finding daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Ramaah tracks closer than usual and gets first run on the field.
scenarios.body: The only horse with some early speed apart from the leader capitalizes on perfect positioning to strike before the closers gear up. His lighter weight and good recent form pay dividends.

watchPoints.text: Steady The Ship could steal this if allowed uncontested lead - watch for any early challenges to test his stamina
Traffic problems likely in straight with six hold-up horses - watch for clear runs and interference
Snapius and Midnight View clash of class performers - watch which gets better position turning for home
Jafimgoso's 60-day break suggests this is a target - watch for sharp Skelton team preparation
Going remains good throughout card - watch for any deterioration affecting hold-up horses
